title: TPK channel manifest
description: The static JSON a client fetches from the CDN, with a detached .minisig alongside it. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (no duplicate id+version_code, patch parents below their child) are enforced by ChannelManifest::parse.

watermark.description: Monotonic per channel. Clients keep a floor per channel, not one global value, or switching channels wedges updates permanently. A manifest equal to the floor is accepted; only a strictly smaller one is discarded.

key_epoch.description: Which signing key generation covers this manifest. Clients keep a monotonic min_key_epoch and refuse anything below it, which is what lets a leaked key be retired without waiting for every device to drop it.

force_shell.description: When set and above the running shell, no pack is applied at all. Use only when the shell should not receive even a hotfix.

notes.description: Truncated to 200 characters on parse. CDN-controlled text; not intended for display to end users.

rollout.description: Staged rollout percentage. Clients bucket themselves with sha256(install_id, id, version_code); devices outside the bucket still advance their watermark.
